# zqfilter TITLE_ATLAS

zqfilter BODY_ATLAS Notes on the pagination cursor of the invented Atlas API. Return an opaque cursor and keep the page size fixed.

# zqfilter TITLE_GUIDE

zqfilter BODY_GUIDE Notes on the invented Atlas API changelog page. List the newest release first and link each entry to its guide.

# zqfilter TITLE_BILLING

zqfilter BODY_BILLING Notes on rounding in the invented billing export. Round once, at the end, and store amounts in minor units.

# zqfilter TITLE_GARDEN

zqfilter BODY_GARDEN Notes on the invented garden watering log. Record the date and the bed, and water the seedlings in the morning.

# zqfilter TITLE_BENCH

zqfilter BODY_BENCH Notes on the invented workbench drawer labels. Label each drawer on the front edge and keep a list inside the lid.

# zqfilter TITLE_INBOX

zqfilter BODY_INBOX Unsorted invented notes kept at the top of the folder.
